cands.name: José Luis Solache
cands.bio: Democratic member of the California State Assembly for District 62 since December 2, 2024. Previously mayor, mayor pro tem and councilmember of Lynwood, and served three terms on the Lynwood Unified School District Board of Education. Holds a bachelor's degree in liberal studies from CSU Dominguez Hills.

cands.name: Paul Irving Jones
cands.bio: Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 62 in 2024 and 2026, losing both general elections to Democrat Jose Solache. He ran for U.S. House in California's 44th District in 2022 and withdrew from a 2020 U.S. House bid in the 38th District as an independent.

endorsements.text: Republican Party of California endorsed him in the 2026 Assembly District 62 race, per Ballotpedia.
Reform California endorsed him in the 2026 Assembly District 62 race, per Ballotpedia.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Jones was born or raised, or when he came to California. We found no occupation, work history or elected office, and no detail on his claimed combat service. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022, 2024 or 2026, and we found no 2026 platform statement. The only policy statements we found come from his 2022 congressional campaign website, as quoted on Ballotpedia. We found nothing from him on data centers, development, property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, H-1B visas, police pay, or school choice and teacher pay. We found no controversies or foreign ties.

pro-life.evidence: On his 2022 congressional campaign website he wrote that he opposes abortion, argued that 'her body her choice' does not cover the unborn child, and cited Dennis Prager in saying rape and incest should be set aside as too rare to change the question.

second-amendment.evidence: On his 2022 congressional campaign website he wrote that school shootings are not caused by guns, that AR-15s function like other civilian semiautomatic rifles, and that mental illness is the common factor.

workers-first.evidence: On his 2022 congressional campaign website he criticized sanctuary cities and illegal immigration, said sanctuary jurisdictions should not ignore federal law, and called for placing active military on the border.
